verses.text: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.
lines: “Yes, at this my heart trembles,
and is moved out of its place.

verses.text: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.
lines: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice,
the sound that goes out of his mouth.

verses.text: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.
lines: He sends it out under the whole sky,
and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

verses.text: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.
lines: After it a voice roars.
He thunders with the voice of his majesty.
He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

verses.text: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.
lines: God thunders marvelously with his voice.
He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

verses.text: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.
lines: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’
likewise to the shower of rain,
and to the showers of his mighty rain.

verses.text: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.
lines: He seals up the hand of every man,
that all men whom he has made may know it.

verses.text: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.
lines: Then the animals take cover,
and remain in their dens.

verses.text: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.
lines: Out of its room comes the storm,
and cold out of the north.

verses.text: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.
lines: By the breath of God, ice is given,
and the width of the waters is frozen.

verses.text: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
lines: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture.
He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

verses.text: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,
lines: It is turned around by his guidance,
that they may do whatever he commands them
on the surface of the habitable world,

verses.text: Whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.
lines: Whether it is for correction, or for his land,
or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

verses.text: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
lines: “Listen to this, Job.
Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

verses.text: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
lines: Do you know how God controls them,
and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

verses.text: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
lines: Do you know the workings of the clouds,
the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

verses.text: You whose clothing is warm, when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?
lines: You whose clothing is warm,
when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

verses.text: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?
lines: Can you, with him, spread out the sky,
which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

verses.text: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.
lines: Teach us what we will tell him,
for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

verses.text: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?
lines: Will it be told him that I would speak?
Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

verses.text: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.
lines: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies,
but the wind passes, and clears them.

verses.text: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.
lines: Out of the north comes golden splendor.
With God is awesome majesty.

verses.text: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
lines: We can’t reach the Almighty.
He is exalted in power.
In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

verses.text: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
lines: Therefore men revere him.
He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
